summary: Backend fully green (26/26 pytest). Frontend Expo web preview loads and all 5 tabs (Home, Podcast, News, Palinsesto, Profilo) render correctly with proper testIDs, live indicator, hero, seed content, day-chip switching, podcast search + category chips, and a functional login/register modal.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation console warnings only: 'shadow* style props are deprecated (use boxShadow)' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: standardize interactive-testID naming — bottom tabs have no data-testid="tab-*" (had to use screen coordinates). Add testID to Tabs.Screen tabBarButton for reliable automation.
Optional: rename login testIDs to match spec if needed (currently login-email/password/submit/toggle-mode/google-login — spec suggested auth-email/auth-submit).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses local import of bcrypt mid-file (line 73) — move to top-level imports.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown are deprecated in FastAPI — consider lifespan handlers.
get_current_user is a helper but each endpoint re-declares Header dependency; consider a Depends() wrapper for DRY.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — technically invalid per spec; safe for MVP but tighten before prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (screens/navigation/forms visible; audio playback not verified on web)

seed_data_creation: Startup seed already creates 6 podcasts, 4 news, 8 programs, and live_status. Backend tests created transient TEST_ prayer/message/contact docs and one dynamic user per run (email test_<ts>@pescatoridiuomini.it). No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Login testIDs are login-email/login-password/login-submit/toggle-mode/google-login/login-close. Podcast chips: podcast-chip-<Category>. Bottom tabs have NO testIDs — click by role/text or coordinates (y≈820, width 390). Palinsesto uses day-chip-<Day> (Italian: Lunedì..Domenica). Prayer form testIDs prayer-text/prayer-anonymous/prayer-submit expected on /prayer route (not verified end-to-end but menu-/prayer link works).
